answer.rationale: Verifier set: c2 (low-cost vendor transition, last cycle's largest unit-cost driver) and c6 (multi-year incumbent commitments unlocking volume pricing without scope erosion) — both directly shape whether negotiation or switching better meets the 18% mandate. Intended action: negotiate_terms with the incumbent on a multi-year commitment to unlock volume pricing (per c6) while using market benchmarks (per c4) to recover margin, avoiding the migration risk of switching vendors with a 14-day clock, no buffer, and 94% line utilization. Kept as a small guarded test rather than a locked commitment; outcome of record pull and incumbent response will decide whether to fall back to switch_primary_vendor.
